newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks higher on bargain-hunting.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks higher on bargain-hunting.

text.p: Jakarta stocks were higher in early trading on Monday following bargain-hunting in big-caps, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index rose 4.69 points, or 0.74 percent, to 642.29 points, after 45 minutes of trading. Advancers led decliners by 43 to 23 with 45 issues unchanged.
"Bargain-hunting in selected big-caps like Sampoerna and Telkom boosted overall sentiment and prompted buying in some second-liners as well," one broker said.
Brokers said they were surprised that reports that state-owned firm Danareksa planned to acquire Soedarpo had failed to attract strong market attention.
"It's very surprising. Reports of an acquisition usually has strong impact, but it seemed it did not work with Soedarpo," one broker said.
Soedarpo rose 50 rupiah to 2,050 rupiah, but only 6,000 shares were traded.
